sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer must monitor whether the organization follows its own privacy policies.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and the organization has policies concerning personal-information protection.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for monitoring compliance with the organization's own personal-information protection policies?

sub_obligations.legal_text: including the assignment of responsibilities
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer's monitoring must include checking whether privacy responsibilities have been properly assigned.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for checking whether privacy-related responsibilities are properly assigned?

sub_obligations.legal_text: awareness-raising and training of staff involved in processing operations
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer's monitoring must include privacy awareness and training for staff who handle personal information.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and staff are involved in processing personal information.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for monitoring privacy awareness and training for staff involved in processing?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and the related audits;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer's monitoring must also include relevant privacy audits.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and relevant audits are conducted.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for monitoring or participating in relevant privacy audits?

sub_obligations.legal_text: to provide advice where requested as regards the data protection impact assessment and monitor its performance pursuant to [Article 35](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-35-gdpr/);
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer must advise on privacy impact assessments when asked and monitor how those assessments are carried out.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and a privacy impact assessment is requested or required.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for advising on privacy impact assessments when requested and monitoring their performance?

sub_obligations.legal_text: to cooperate with the supervisory authority;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer must cooperate with the relevant privacy regulator.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and interaction with the supervisory authority is relevant.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer responsibility for cooperating with the relevant supervisory authority?

sub_obligations.legal_text: to act as the contact point for the supervisory authority on issues relating to processing
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer must serve as the organization's contact person for the regulator on matters involving personal-information processing.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy identify the privacy officer as the contact point for the supervisory authority on personal-information processing matters?

sub_obligations.legal_text: including the prior consultation referred to in [Article 36](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-36-gdpr/)
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer's contact role includes handling or coordinating prior consultation with the regulator when Article 36 applies.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when prior consultation under Article 36 is required or otherwise relevant.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy assign the privacy officer a role in coordinating or serving as the contact point for Article 36 prior consultation?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and to consult, where appropriate, with regard to any other matter.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The privacy officer should consult the regulator on other relevant privacy matters when appropriate.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when consultation with the supervisory authority on another matter is appropriate.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy allow or require the privacy officer to consult the supervisory authority on other relevant privacy matters when appropriate?

sub_obligations.legal_text: The data protection officer shall in the performance of his or her tasks have due regard to the risk associated with processing operations, taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When carrying out their responsibilities, the privacy officer must take the risks of the processing into account, including its nature, scale, circumstances, and purposes.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when a data protection officer has been designated and is performing the tasks described in this Article.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy require the privacy officer to take processing risks into account, including the nature, scope, context, and purposes of the processing, when performing their responsibilities?

article_name: General principle for transfers

sub_obligations.legal_text: Any transfer of personal data which are undergoing processing or are intended for processing after transfer to a third country or to an international organisation shall take place only if, subject to the other provisions of this Regulation, the conditions laid down in this Chapter are complied with by the controller and processor, including for onward transfers of personal data from the third country or an international organisation to another third country or to another international organisation.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: Personal information may be sent outside the EU or to an international organization only when the required GDPR international-transfer rules are followed, including when it is later sent onward to another destination.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when personal information is transferred to a third country or international organization, including onward transfers from that destination.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization makes international transfers of personal information, does the policy require each transfer and onward transfer to comply with the applicable GDPR international-transfer requirements?

sub_obligations.legal_text: All provisions in this Chapter shall be applied in order to ensure that the level of protection of natural persons guaranteed by this Regulation is not undermined.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: International transfers must be handled in a way that does not reduce the level of privacy protection provided by GDPR.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when personal information is transferred to a third country or international organization.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy state that international transfers must preserve the level of privacy protection provided by GDPR and must not undermine people's rights?

article_name: Transfers on the basis of an adequacy decision

sub_obligations.legal_text: A transfer of personal data to a third country or an international organisation may take place where the Commission has decided that the third country, a territory or one or more specified sectors within that third country, or the international organisation in question ensures an adequate level of protection.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The organization may transfer personal information to a country or international organization outside the EU using an adequacy decision only when the European Commission has recognized that destination as providing sufficient privacy protection.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when personal information is transferred to a third country or international organization and the organization relies on an adequacy decision as the transfer mechanism.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on an adequacy decision for an international transfer, does the policy require verification that the specific destination, territory, sector, or international organization is covered by a current European Commission adequacy decision?

article_name: Transfers subject to appropriate safeguards

sub_obligations.legal_text: In the absence of a decision pursuant to [Article 45](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-45-gdpr/)(3), a controller or processor may transfer personal data to a third country or an international organisation only if the controller or processor has provided appropriate safeguards
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When no European Commission adequacy decision covers the destination, the organization may transfer personal information outside the EU only after putting appropriate protection measures in place.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when personal information is transferred to a third country or international organization and no applicable Article 45(3) adequacy decision exists.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization makes an international transfer without relying on an adequacy decision, does the policy require an appropriate transfer safeguard to be established before the transfer?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and on condition that enforceable data subject rights and effective legal remedies for data subjects are available.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: People whose information is transferred must have enforceable privacy rights and effective ways to obtain legal protection.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when an international transfer relies on Article 46 appropriate safeguards.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy require international transfers relying on Article 46 safeguards to provide enforceable privacy rights and effective legal remedies to affected people?

sub_obligations.legal_text: a legally binding and enforceable instrument between public authorities or bodies;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may use a legally binding and enforceable agreement between public authorities or bodies as its protection mechanism.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on an Article 46(2) safeguard and the transfer is covered by a legally binding instrument between public authorities or bodies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on an agreement between public authorities as its transfer safeguard, does the policy require that agreement to be legally binding and enforceable?

sub_obligations.legal_text: binding corporate rules in accordance with [Article 47](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-47-gdpr/);
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may rely on approved binding rules governing transfers within a corporate group, provided they meet Article 47 requirements.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on binding corporate rules as its international-transfer safeguard.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on binding corporate rules for international transfers, does the policy require those rules to comply with Article 47?

sub_obligations.legal_text: standard data protection clauses adopted by the Commission in accordance with the examination procedure referred to in [Article 93](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-93-gdpr/)(2);
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may rely on standard privacy clauses adopted by the European Commission under the required approval procedure.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on Commission-adopted standard data protection clauses.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on standard privacy clauses for an international transfer, does the policy require the clauses to be those adopted by the European Commission under the applicable procedure?

sub_obligations.legal_text: standard data protection clauses adopted by a supervisory authority and approved by the Commission pursuant to the examination procedure referred to in [Article 93](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-93-gdpr/)(2);
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may rely on standard privacy clauses adopted by a privacy regulator and approved by the European Commission.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on supervisory-authority-adopted standard clauses.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on standard privacy clauses adopted by a supervisory authority, does the policy require that the clauses have been approved by the European Commission under the applicable procedure?

sub_obligations.legal_text: an approved code of conduct pursuant to [Article 40](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-40-gdpr/) together with binding and enforceable commitments of the controller or processor in the third country to apply the appropriate safeguards, including as regards data subjects’ rights; or
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may rely on an approved privacy code of conduct together with binding and enforceable commitments by the recipient organization to apply the required protections, including people's rights.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on an approved Article 40 code of conduct as its transfer safeguard.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on an approved code of conduct for an international transfer, does the policy require binding and enforceable commitments by the recipient to apply the required protections, including privacy rights?

sub_obligations.legal_text: an approved certification mechanism pursuant to [Article 42](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-42-gdpr/) together with binding and enforceable commitments of the controller or processor in the third country to apply the appropriate safeguards, including as regards data subjects’ rights.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may rely on an approved privacy certification together with binding and enforceable commitments by the recipient organization to apply the required protections, including people's rights.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on an approved Article 42 certification mechanism as its transfer safeguard.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on an approved certification mechanism for an international transfer, does the policy require binding and enforceable commitments by the recipient to apply the required protections, including privacy rights?

sub_obligations.legal_text: contractual clauses between the controller or processor and the controller, processor or the recipient of the personal data in the third country or international organisation; or
sub_obligations.plain_summary: With approval from the relevant privacy regulator, an international transfer may use contractual protections between the sending organization and the organization receiving or handling the information abroad.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on contractual clauses under Article 46(3) and has obtained the required supervisory-authority authorization.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on contractual clauses under Article 46(3), does the policy require the relevant supervisory-authority authorization before using them?

sub_obligations.legal_text: provisions to be inserted into administrative arrangements between public authorities or bodies which include enforceable and effective data subject rights.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: With approval from the relevant privacy regulator, public authorities may use administrative arrangements containing enforceable and effective privacy rights.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization is a public authority or body and relies on administrative arrangements under Article 46(3).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on administrative arrangements under Article 46(3), does the policy require the arrangements to include enforceable and effective privacy rights and have the required supervisory-authority authorization?

article_name: Derogations for specific situations

sub_obligations.legal_text: the data subject has explicitly consented to the proposed transfer, after having been informed of the possible risks of such transfers for the data subject due to the absence of an adequacy decision and appropriate safeguards;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer without an adequacy decision or suitable safeguards may rely on a person's explicit consent only after they have been told about the possible risks of the transfer.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard and the organization relies on explicit consent as the transfer basis.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on explicit consent for an international transfer without an adequacy decision or appropriate safeguards, does the policy require explicit consent after informing the person about the possible risks of the transfer?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is necessary for the performance of a contract between the data subject and the controller or the implementation of pre-contractual measures taken at the data subject’s request;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made when it is necessary to perform a contract with the person or to take requested steps before entering into a contract.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard and the transfer is necessary for a contract or requested pre-contractual steps.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the contract-based exception for an international transfer, does the policy require the transfer to be necessary for a contract with the person or for requested steps before entering into a contract?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is necessary for the conclusion or performance of a contract concluded in the interest of the data subject between the controller and another natural or legal person;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made when it is necessary to enter into or perform a contract made for the person's benefit between the organization and another person or organization.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard and the transfer is necessary for a contract made in the person's interest.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on this contract-based exception, does the policy require the transfer to be necessary for a contract made in the person's interest with another person or organization?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is necessary for important reasons of public interest;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made when it is necessary for an important public-interest reason.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard and the transfer is necessary for an important public-interest reason.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the public-interest exception for an international transfer, does the policy identify the important public-interest reason that makes the transfer necessary?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is necessary for the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made when it is necessary to establish, pursue, or defend a legal claim.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard and the transfer is necessary for a legal claim.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the legal-claims exception for an international transfer, does the policy require the transfer to be necessary to establish, pursue, or defend a legal claim?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is necessary in order to protect the vital interests of the data subject or of other persons, where the data subject is physically or legally incapable of giving consent;
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made to protect someone's vital interests when that person cannot physically or legally give consent.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when there is no applicable adequacy decision or appropriate safeguard, the transfer is necessary to protect vital interests, and the person is physically or legally unable to give consent.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the vital-interests exception, does the policy require the transfer to be necessary to protect vital interests and apply only when the person cannot physically or legally give consent?

sub_obligations.legal_text: the transfer is made from a register which according to Union or Member State law is intended to provide information to the public and which is open to consultation either by the public in general or by any person who can demonstrate a legitimate interest, but only to the extent that the conditions laid down by Union or Member State law for consultation are fulfilled in the particular case.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An international transfer may be made from a legally established public register that is open for consultation, but only when the legal conditions for accessing that register are met in the particular case.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer comes from a legally established public register that is open to the public generally or to people who can show a legitimate interest.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the public-register exception, does the policy require the register to be legally intended to provide public information and require all applicable legal conditions for consultation to be met?

sub_obligations.legal_text: a transfer to a third country or an international organisation may take place only if the transfer is not repetitive
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When none of the usual international-transfer mechanisms or specific exceptions applies, a fallback transfer must be a one-off or non-repetitive transfer.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer cannot rely on an Article 45 or Article 46 mechanism, including binding corporate rules, and none of the specific exceptions in the first subparagraph of Article 49(1) applies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route under Article 49(1), does the policy require the transfer not to be repetitive?

sub_obligations.legal_text: concerns only a limited number of data subjects
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The exceptional fallback route may cover only a limited number of people.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer cannot rely on an Article 45 or Article 46 mechanism and none of the specific exceptions in the first subparagraph of Article 49(1) applies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route under Article 49(1), does the policy require the transfer to concern only a limited number of people?

sub_obligations.legal_text: is necessary for the purposes of compelling legitimate interests pursued by the controller which are not overridden by the interests or rights and freedoms of the data subject
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The exceptional fallback route may be used only when the transfer is necessary for a strong business interest that is not outweighed by the person's rights and freedoms.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer cannot rely on an Article 45 or Article 46 mechanism and none of the specific exceptions in the first subparagraph of Article 49(1) applies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require a documented assessment showing that the transfer is necessary for a compelling organizational interest that is not outweighed by the affected person's rights and freedoms?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and the controller has assessed all the circumstances surrounding the data transfer
sub_obligations.plain_summary: Before relying on the exceptional fallback route, the organization must assess all relevant circumstances surrounding the transfer.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer cannot rely on an Article 45 or Article 46 mechanism and none of the specific exceptions in the first subparagraph of Article 49(1) applies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require an assessment of all circumstances surrounding the proposed international transfer?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and has on the basis of that assessment provided suitable safeguards with regard to the protection of personal data.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: After assessing the transfer, the organization must put suitable measures in place to protect the personal information being transferred.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the transfer cannot rely on an Article 45 or Article 46 mechanism and none of the specific exceptions in the first subparagraph of Article 49(1) applies.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require suitable privacy safeguards to be established based on the documented transfer assessment?

sub_obligations.legal_text: The controller shall inform the supervisory authority of the transfer.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: The organization must notify the privacy regulator when it makes a transfer under the exceptional fallback route.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization uses the exceptional fallback route described in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization uses the exceptional fallback route for an international transfer, does the policy require the supervisory authority to be informed?

sub_obligations.legal_text: The controller shall, in addition to providing the information referred to in [Articles 13](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-13-gdpr/) and [14](https://gdpr-info.eu/art-14-gdpr/), inform the data subject of the transfer
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When using the exceptional fallback route, the organization must tell the affected person about the international transfer in addition to the normal privacy information.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization uses the exceptional fallback route described in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization uses the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require affected people to be informed about the international transfer in addition to the information required under Articles 13 and 14?

sub_obligations.legal_text: and on the compelling legitimate interests pursued.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When using the exceptional fallback route, the organization must also tell the affected person about the strong organizational interest supporting the transfer.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization uses the exceptional fallback route described in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization uses the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require affected people to be informed about the compelling organizational interest supporting the transfer?

sub_obligations.legal_text: A transfer pursuant to point (g) of the first subparagraph of paragraph 1 shall not involve the entirety of the personal data or entire categories of the personal data contained in the register.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: A transfer from a public register cannot include all the personal information or an entire category of information held in that register.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on the public-register exception under Article 49(1)(g).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the public-register exception, does the policy prevent transferring the entire set of personal information or an entire category of information contained in the register?

sub_obligations.legal_text: Where the register is intended for consultation by persons having a legitimate interest, the transfer shall be made only at the request of those persons or if they are to be the recipients.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: If a public register is available only to people with a legitimate interest, information from it may be transferred only when those people request it or are the intended recipients.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when relying on the public-register exception and the register is intended for consultation by people with a legitimate interest.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on a register accessible only to people with a legitimate interest, does the policy require the transfer to occur only at their request or when they are the intended recipients?

sub_obligations.legal_text: Points (a), (b) and (c) of the first subparagraph of paragraph 1 and the second subparagraph thereof shall not apply to activities carried out by public authorities in the exercise of their public powers.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: Public authorities acting under their official powers cannot rely on the consent, contract, or exceptional fallback routes described in these parts of Article 49.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization is a public authority exercising public powers.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization is a public authority exercising public powers, does the policy prevent reliance on the Article 49(1)(a), (b), (c), and second-subparagraph exceptions?

sub_obligations.legal_text: The public interest referred to in point (d) of the first subparagraph of paragraph 1 shall be recognised in Union law or in the law of the Member State to which the controller is subject.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: An organization can rely on the important-public-interest exception only when that public interest is recognized by applicable European or national law.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on the Article 49(1)(d) public-interest exception.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization relies on the important-public-interest exception, does the policy require the relevant public interest to be recognized in applicable European or national law?

sub_obligations.legal_text: In the absence of an adequacy decision, Union or Member State law may, for important reasons of public interest, expressly set limits to the transfer of specific categories of personal data to a third country or an international organisation.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: European or national law may expressly restrict transfers of particular types of personal information when there is an important public-interest reason and no adequacy decision applies.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when applicable European or national law contains such an express restriction on a specific category of personal information.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If applicable law expressly restricts an international transfer for an important public-interest reason, does the policy require the organization to identify and comply with that restriction?

sub_obligations.legal_text: Member States shall notify such provisions to the Commission.
sub_obligations.plain_summary: National governments must notify the European Commission about laws that impose these transfer restrictions.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only for Member State authorities that have adopted such transfer restrictions.
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: Does the policy describe the organization's responsibility, if any, for notifying the European Commission about applicable national transfer restrictions?

sub_obligations.legal_text: The controller or processor shall document the assessment as well as the suitable safeguards referred to in the second subparagraph of paragraph 1 of this Article
sub_obligations.plain_summary: When using the exceptional fallback route, the organization must document both its transfer assessment and the safeguards it put in place.
sub_obligations.applicability_condition: Only when the organization relies on the exceptional fallback route described in the second subparagraph of Article 49(1).
sub_obligations.evidence_prompt: If the organization uses the exceptional fallback route, does the policy require the transfer assessment and the safeguards used to be documented?
